Appearance:
 Shri Tarun Sengar - Advocate for the applicant.

Ms. Geeta Yadav - Government Advocate for the respondent/S
 Order

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.335/2024 dated 29.09.2024 registered at Police Station Sanjeevni Nagar, District Jabalpur for the offences under Sections 420,
467, 468, 471 & 120-B of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the applicant contends that the present applicant has not committed any offence and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Earlier bail application of the present applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 13.12.2024 in M.Cr.C. No.52953/2024 with liberty to revive the prayer after filing of charge-sheet.
It is contended by the counsel that now,
charge-sheet in the matter has been filed.
The applicant is in custody since 06.11.2024.

Co- accused persons namely, Bhavani Choudhary and Prashant Salojia have NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:6140 2 MCRC-5849-2025 already been released on bail by this Court.

Therefore,
he is no more required for custodial interrogation.
Thus, applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

3. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and submitted that present applicant was instrumental while forging the sale-deed, therefore, taking into consideration the role played by the present applicant as well as nature of offence, he is not entitled to be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
5. A perusal of the case diary it reflects that charge-sheet in the matter has already been filed and the present applicant is in custody since 06.11.2024.
Co-accused persons namely, Bhavani Choudhary and Prashant Salojia have already been released on bail by this Court.

6. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and also the fact that charge-sheet in the matter has already been filed, this Court is of the considered view that it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant-Monu Sahu shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:6140 3 MCRC-5849-2025 pendency of trial.
8.
It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
9. Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
